fixtureMethod: Static close views use real Character.update and real Skater.startGrind on actual rails, with simulation stopped. Static grabs represent rising air (+3 m/s vertical velocity) so landing anticipation is not falsely triggered by a frozen falling pose. Native-controller cases advance the real application separately.
